title: Co-NavGPT: Multi-Robot Cooperative Visual Semantic Navigation Using Vision Language Models

defines.name: Co-NavGPT
defines.definition: A multi-robot cooperative visual semantic navigation framework that uses a vision-language model as a global planner to assign frontiers and coordinate exploration.

problem: Existing visual navigation methods are mostly single-robot and lack common-sense reasoning, making them inefficient and less robust in complex unknown environments.
